title: Knocked Up
score_note: the rare comedy that keeps the marriage in frame

beats.name: THE NIGHTCLUB
cap: alison meets ben at a club the night of her
promotion; they drink and sleep together
beats.tag: MEET-CUTE — the whole premise in one night

beats.name: THE MORNING AFTER
cap: over breakfast they find they have nothing
in common; ben goes home disappointed
beats.tag: FALSE ENDING — no reason to stay

beats.name: EIGHT WEEKS LATER
cap: alison's morning sickness hits during an
interview, and she learns she is pregnant
beats.tag: DISCOVERY — one night becomes nine months

beats.name: BEN SIGNS ON
cap: alison calls ben; he shows up for the
doctor's appointments and tries to help
beats.tag: GESTURE — the slacker turns up anyway

beats.name: MEETING THE FAMILY
cap: ben meets debbie and pete, alison's sister
and brother-in-law, and bonds with pete
beats.tag: BFF — the friendship that carries the B plot

beats.name: THE ROOMMATES
cap: ben's jobless roommates run a celebrity
nudity website and mock his new life
beats.tag: BFF — the friends he has to grow past

beats.name: DEBBIE'S SUSPICIONS
cap: debbie suspects pete is cheating and their
marriage comes apart beside the romance
beats.tag: OBSTACLE — the marriage in the next room

beats.name: VEGAS WITHOUT HER
cap: ben goes to las vegas with pete for the
fantasy baseball draft, leaving alison
beats.tag: ESCAPADE — pete's escape hatch, lent out

beats.name: THE SPLIT
cap: ben and alison break up, and debbie and
pete's marriage is falling apart too
beats.tag: BREAKUP — the middle act's whole point

beats.name: BEN GROWS UP
cap: ben reads up on pregnancy with his friends
and finds a place of his own to be ready
beats.tag: TURN — the slacker starts to show up

beats.name: THE BIRTH
cap: alison goes into labor; ben reaches the
hospital and stays for the birth
beats.tag: END — a family of a kind nobody planned
